setup.pencil: D_G4(z), the closed constructed analytical G4 block
setup.parameter_domain: the common holomorphic domain on which the history solution and Stokes rows are defined

rowwise_identity.theta_row: vanishes by the declared arithmetic-adjoint/source-range relation
rowwise_identity.strength: parameterwise, shellwise, after completion, and under every finite z derivative

theorem.statement: D_G4(z)Psi_z=0 for every z in the common domain, not merely for z in div(Xi)
theorem.nonzero: Psi_z is nonzero because its theta coordinate equals 1
theorem.consequence: D_G4(z) is noninvertible throughout that domain

fredholm_determinant_no_go.assume: D_G4(z) is represented by a holomorphic Fredholm/determinant-class pencil whose determinant section det_F D_G4(z) detects invertibility
fredholm_determinant_no_go.then: det_F D_G4(z)=0 identically on every connected component
fredholm_determinant_no_go.incompatibility: det_F D_G4(z)=c(z)Xi(z) with c holomorphic and nowhere zero is impossible because Xi is not identically zero

xi_divisibility_semantics.true_statement: the canonical residual is zero and hence belongs to Xi O(U_ar)
xi_divisibility_semantics.information_content: none about the Xi divisor, because the same vanishing holds off the divisor
xi_divisibility_semantics.multiplicity: all jets vanish for the stronger reason that the residual is identically zero

required_repair_for_independent_detectio: use a different source-derived pencil or quotient in which the global Stokes kernel section is removed before forming the determinant
or define an Evans function on the transverse/cokernel determinant line rather than from the identically null canonical codiagonal
then prove its determinant section equals a nonvanishing factor times Xi and that its kernel states satisfy the closed Green boundary condition
hostiles: claim that identically zero residual detects the discrete Xi divisor
claim finite Xi-jet vanishing is independent when every parameter jet already vanishes
attach a Fredholm determinant to the unreduced pencil and identify it with Xi
conclusion: The tetrahedral analytical construction is closed, but its canonical Evans section is a global gauge/Stokes kernel section. It cannot itself be the Xi-detecting spectral branch. The correct next object is a transverse reduced pencil or determinant line, not another tetrahedral face.
